Romanina — Rome, Italy

Average day Higher caution advised night

In detail

Romanina is a mixed residential and institutional area near Cinecittà and the Tor Vergata university satellite campus. Recent press documents a genuine and recurring drug-trafficking problem: an organized delivery ring dismantled between Romanina and Frascati, a separate raid netting eight arrests for a round-the-clock drug operation shared with the EUR district, an explosion at a residential building investigated as a criminal intimidation act tied to drug clans, and a report describing a fortified apartment functioning as a drug den. This is a well-documented, recurring pattern rather than an isolated incident, justifying red at night; daytime university and residential life continues normally, so yellow.
